title: New Paradigm for Evaluating Scholar Summaries: A Facet-aware Metric and A Meta-evaluation Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing automated summarization metrics (such as QuestEval and ACU) to demonstrate how they erroneously penalize generated summaries for containing correct claims that are simply missing from the reference text (reference bias), and mitigating this by correlating metric scores with human judgments on the ScholarSum benchmark.

Critiquing fine-grained QA-based and verification methods for relying on a limited set of sampled semantic units (e.g., isolated QA pairs or atomic content units) that fail to comprehensively capture the full continuum of meaning in a scientific abstract.
